scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: [ "$(git branch --show-current)" != "main" ] || [ "$ALLOW_MAIN_COMMIT" = "1" ] || { echo 'Commit na main so com o ok de Lucas: ALLOW_MAIN_COMMIT=1 (veja AGENTS.md).'; exit 1; }
simple-git-hooks.pre-push: [ "$ALLOW_MAIN_PUSH" = "1" ] || ! grep -q ' refs/heads/main ' || { echo 'Push na main so com o ok de Lucas: ALLOW_MAIN_PUSH=1 (veja AGENTS.md).'; exit 1; }
